title: A range stays on top when you pick a clip, and its right-click acts on that clip's stretch
goal: Picking a range of time and then clicking a clip (a sound, a recording, a title) should keep the range: it stays visible and drawn above the clips, the clip is picked too, and right-clicking inside the range offers what can be done to that clip over just that stretch, such as Mute Section on a sound. Today picking anything sends the range to the background, so range edits on one clip are confusing to reach.
notes:
User's words (2026-10-12): "when i select a range, and then click on timeline boxes like an audio clip, I want the item to be selected, but the range to still be on top. Then I can for example, right click on the selected range and 'mute' a section. This should apply to whatever range operations we have for different types of things selected, but right now I find it confusing to use because it goes into the background whenever i select something."

From code reading (not run): today a range and a pick are exclusive by design. EditorState+TrackRange.swift pickTrackRange (:444-452) lets go of the picked layers ('the way a Final Cut range replaces the clips'); trackRangeHeld (:463-468) only counts while selectedLayerID is nil and nothing else is picked, so clicking a clip effectively drops the range from being in hand; rulerRangeInHand is separate (EditorState+RulerRange.swift, menu rows :297+). The user wants the Premiere model (In/Out persists, the selection is separate, range operations apply to the selected clips within In/Out). There is no Mute Section today (no 'Mute' range op found; track mute exists at TimelineTrackRows.swift:370). Sound gain lives in the sound model (AudioMix ramps); a section mute is two ramps and a floor.
acceptance: Reproduce first at Next defaults with both kinds of range (a ruler range / In and Out, and an Option-drag range on tracks): pick the range, click an audio clip, record what happens to the range (drawn behind, dimmed, dropped) and what the right-click offers

The range and the picked items are separate: clicking a clip, sound, title or zoom inside or outside a range picks it and the range stays held, drawn on top of the clips (the band and its edges over the clip bars, not behind), until Clear Range, Escape (which clears the range first, then the pick), or a new range replaces it

Right-click inside the range with items picked: a menu of the range operations that apply to the picked items' kinds, acting only on the picked items and only within the range. At least: for a sound, Mute Section (volume to silence across the range with short ramps so there is no click), Lower Volume..., Normalize Section, Clean Noise in Section; for a recording or video, Delete Section, Ripple Delete Section, Split at Range Edges, Speed for Section, Freeze Frame Here, Add Zoom over Range, Hide Picture for Section; for a title or graphic, Trim to Range; for keys, Delete Keys in Range. With nothing picked, the existing whole-timeline range menu (EditorState+RulerRange.swift rulerRangeMenuRows: Split at Range Edges, Merge, Cut, Copy, Delete, Ripple Delete, Clear Range, Add Captions for Range, Export Range) stays as today
An inventory in the audit lists every range operation that exists today and which item kinds each applies to, so the menu is built from one table rather than per-kind code
Each section operation is one undo step, and its result shows on the clip (for example the muted stretch draws its volume line at the floor with the ramps visible)
The same operations are in the menu bar with keys where they already have one, enabled when a range and a matching pick exist

A walk picks a range, clicks an audio clip, checks the range is still held and on top, right-clicks inside it, chooses Mute Section, and checks the sound is silent within the range and unchanged outside it (MEASURED level at three points)
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Reproduced at Next defaults (walk /tmp/rangerepro/repro.json, sample recording + sample music): (1) ruler range 0:03-0:06 drawn, then Sample Music clicked: In/Out stay 3000/6000 but the wash down the tracks vanishes, only the ruler band is left (2-ruler-range-then-clip-sc.png); right-click on the music inside the range offers the plain clip menu (Split at Playhead ... Delete, Ripple Delete), no range rows. (2) Option-drag range on Audio 2 0:03-0:06, then the clip clicked: expectTimelinePick says 'picked Sample Music', rangeOn [] - the range is dropped outright. Cause: selectedLayerID didSet calls letGoOfTimelinePicks (clears trackRangeInHand) and rulerRangeHeld/trackRangeHeld are nil whenever anything is picked.

Review before building: a Premiere editor expects In/Out to persist while clips are selected and Lift/Extract or effects to act on the selected clips within In/Out; the app drew a ruler range only while nothing was picked and dropped a track range on any clip click. Risks weighed: (a) Delete with a range and a picked clip: chose Delete Section (range on top, matching Escape order) but only when the pick overlaps the range and nothing smaller (zoom, keys, cut) was picked on top, else the old pick behaviour; (b) a box pick still replaces a range (a new pick of time), a click on empty track space still lets a track range go; (c) marks set with I and O stay marks, not a range in hand, as before. No mock covers this surface.

Built: core table SectionOperation + section edits (Sources/PhotonzCore/RangeSection.swift, 31 tests in RangeSectionTests); app layer EditorState+RangeSection.swift (rangeKept / rangeSection / sectionTakesTheDelete, rows, edits as one undo step each); selection no longer drops trackRangeInHand (letGoOfTimelinePicks(keepingRange:)); wash and band draw rulerRangeKept / trackRangeKept; clip, ruler and lane right-clicks lead with the section rows (ruler: whole-range rows move to an All Tracks submenu); Delete/Ripple Delete route to the section (key path, Clip menu rows titled Delete Section / Ripple Delete Section, clip menu's own Delete loses its key hint then); Escape clears a track range before the pick (ruler range already did); Sequence > Picked in Range in the menu bar. Harness: expectLevel silentAt/fullAt read the mix; expectTimelinePick reports a kept ruler range as 'every track'.

Found and fixed on the way (reproduced first, tests failed without the fix): Lift and Extract left a sound's level points where they were while the sound moved, so after Delete Section the music's second half went silent at 0:13 (picture in /tmp/photonz-playtest run before the fix). AudioLevel.removeStretch now carries the line in MarkedStretch keep() and extractStretch; tests LevelFollowsATakenStretchTests.

Review after building (real app, probe): range, pick and wash read together; Mute Section measured silent at 3.2/4.5/5.8s and full at 1.5/8/12s; Normalize Section raised the sample music's 3-6s by +2.7 dB to -1 dBFS; Lower Volume -12 dB landed at -9.3 dB on top of it. Rough items: Clean Noise / Hide Picture for a stretch -> filed clean-noise-and-hide-picture-work-on-one-stretch; right-click on a sound's level line opens nothing (pre-existing, reproduced) -> filed a-right-click-on-a-sound-s-level-line-opens-the; Freeze Frame Here renamed Freeze Frame for Section, Normalize Section capped at +6 dB, Lower Volume as a 4-step submenu, section rows lead a picked clip's menu even outside the range, I/O marks not a range in hand -> left rough here (judgement calls the user can react to on the audit, none broken).

A range (ruler or Option-drag across tracks) stays in hand and drawn over the clips when a clip is picked; right-click on the pick, the ruler stretch or a lane under it leads with the section rows from one table (SectionOperation, Sources/PhotonzCore/RangeSection.swift; app EditorState+RangeSection.swift): Mute Section, Lower Volume, Normalize Section, Split at Range Edges, Delete/Ripple Delete Section, Speed/Freeze Frame for Section, Add Zoom over Range, Trim to Range, Delete Keys in Range, each one undo step; Delete/Shift-Delete take the section; Escape clears the range before the pick; Sequence > Picked in Range in the menu bar. Also fixed Lift/Extract leaving a sound's level line behind. Verified: 31 new core tests + full suite (12,783) green; a-range-stays-on-top-of-a-pick-walk at Next defaults measures silence at 3.2/4.5/5.8s and full level at 1.5/8/12s, one undo step, Escape order, track-range Delete; picked-in-range-menu-bar-walk; 50 related walks green. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-12-range-on-a-pick.json. Clean Noise / Hide Picture for a stretch filed as clean-noise-and-hide-picture-work-on-one-stretch.
